reviews.proposedResponsibilityReview: Planner route composition owns section/project selection, current bootstrap and optional All tasks client catalog. The new picker isolates URL scope interaction in PlannerClientScope; grouping and table presentation remain outside this controller. No authorization/transport orchestration added.

Existing public submit state, conditional displayed answers and attachment collection remain one cohesive form lifecycle. This patch changes only card headings, fieldset styling and alert/button placement; transport validation, abort lifetime, in-flight guard and input retention stay canonical and unchanged.

TaskViews is the existing permitted-task rendering owner for list, board, calendar and timeline/Gantt presentations, selected through one typed Props interface. These modes reuse canonical task/date/status helpers and emit the same parent-owned select/open/complete/move callbacks; the only local state is Calendar display month. This patch adds client section headings and compact grouped columns while reusing the sole TaskList row implementation. Group derivation is separately owned by the pure task-client-groups helper; current reads, permissions, writes, pending/error state and editors remain TaskWorkspace/its established owners. There is no second query, transport, authorization, persistence or mutation lifecycle in this module. Its 408-line size is a review trigger; retaining these closely related renderers avoids an unrelated mechanical split, subject to root independent whole-module acceptance.

Single table column definition still owns selection, task opening and completion presentation for flat/grouped views. Grouped rows add current project labels and omit time totals; no duplicate task-row implementation or new dispatch behavior. Native operations remain TaskWorkspace responsibility.

One task workspace composes its query/filter model, toolbar, selection, results and existing dialogs. This patch adds only local Group by state and calls the separate typed presentation grouping helper. Existing fixed-operation dispatch, scope predicate and dialog owners remain unchanged. No additional native lifecycle or unrelated domain added.

Existing task-page local model owns query, filters, selection and task actions. New groupBy is presentation-only local state; no persistence or transport field is invented. Current read disposal remains useCapiroQuery/ApplicationBoundary.

One bounded task toolbar uses canonical SelectInput/Tabs/actions. The sole added control switches All tasks list grouping. Existing controls and handlers remain unchanged; no duplicated filtering algorithm.

Canonical Planner presentation stylesheet gains only client group card/header/table geometry. Public form card styling is in its own public-form.module.css owner because its public page differs from authenticated Planner. No global/common override. Final automatic table layout honors name/metadata cell widths with visually hidden semantic headers; fixed layout had incorrectly equalized columns.

Existing Workspace feature stylesheet remains canonical. Exactly owned filter rules now target actual Radix combobox triggers plus phone wrapping; all editor/workflow rules remain unchanged. A broad CSS extraction would be unrelated to this bounded repair.

note: Proposed exact-source responsibility review only; root owns registry acceptance. No scanner/registry edits.
